title: Finite-cover scalar localization gives uniform power torsion
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$ be the completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and let $C\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ be any object of the derived category of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$-modules. Let $\{U_j\to X\}_{j=1}^t$ be a finite covering in $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and for each $j$ let $C|_{U_j}$ be the termwise restriction of $C$ to the slice $X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U_j$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], an object of the derived category $D_j$ of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}|_{U_j}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; $D_j$ is $\mathcal O_E$-linear. Suppose that for every $j$ the image of $C|_{U_j}$ in the scalar localization $D_j[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization] is a zero object, equivalently that $\varpi_E^{N_j}\operatorname{id}_{C|_{U_j}}=0$ in $D_j$ for some $N_j\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$. Then there exists $N\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ such that $\varpi_E^N\mathcal H^d(C)=0$, as a sheaf of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$-modules, for every $d\in\mathbf Z$. The case $t=0$ is permitted when the empty family covers $X$.

proof.text: Unfold the tensor-Hom scalar localization. The identity of a zero object is zero, so 1 tensor id of each restricted object vanishes. IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff for the localization tensor product supplies a power of the uniformizer annihilating its identity. Choose these exponents a_j and set M = Finset.univ.sup a; this is zero when the indexing type is empty.

source.place: tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule, together with IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff and the definition of ScalarLocalization.localization.

proof.text: From the recorded coefficient DVR theorem extract its local-ring instance, DVR instance, unit criterion and the generator equation for the chosen uniformizer p. The integer ell is nonzero and has absolute value less than one, so it is not a unit. Mathlib DVR factorization therefore gives ell = v*p^e with v a unit and e>0. For each j, a_j <= M <= e*M; multiplying the local zero equation proves ell^M times the local identity is zero. Replace the natural-number cast action by repeated addition. This avoids requiring compatibility between the independent Linear instances and the restriction functors.

source.place: irreducible_iff_uniformizer and eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible; the chosen generator and unit criterion are from Padic.extension_integers_dvr. Positivity follows from Padic.norm_p_lt_one and spectralNorm_extends.

proof.text: Derived homology is additive: its composite with the additive localization Qh is isomorphic to additive homotopy-category homology, and Localization.functor_additive_iff descends additivity. Slice restriction is exact by ringedOverFunctor_exactGeneral. Use the proved library isomorphism mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso to identify restricted global homology with homology of the restricted object. Additivity sends the ell^M identity equation to homology, and conjugation by this isomorphism yields zero for restriction of ell^M times every global homology identity.

source.place: Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso; exactness is ringedOverFunctor_exactGeneral, and additivity descends using Localization.functor_additive_iff and homologyFunctorFactorsh.

proof.text: Forget module actions faithfully. A sheaf map whose restrictions to all slices of the covering are zero is zero: on an object V apply sheaf separatedness to CoversTop.cover V; each covering arrow domain admits a map g to some U_j, and the component at Over.mk g of the local zero equation is the needed component zero. Naturality completes separatedness. This proves ell^M times every global homology identity is zero, including for an empty covering.

source.place: Presheaf.IsSheaf.hom_ext, using GrothendieckTopology.CoversTop.cover and SheafOfModules.toSheaf faithfulness.

proof.text: Apply homology additivity globally to obtain H^d(ell^M id_C)=0. Compose with the image under homology of (v inverse)^M id_C. Functoriality, bilinearity of composition and ell=v*p^e simplify this to H^d(p^(e*M) id_C)=0. The common exponent e*M is independent of d; when the cover is empty M=0. No linearity of homology or of restriction for the supplied coefficient actions is assumed.
